Documented reconnaissance findings thoroughly enough to enable follow-on automation with skill cards

key_outcomes.summary: Reconnaissance phase shows promise but execution stagnates on pivot to exploitation, requiring targeted skill reinforcement and experiment prioritization.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Repeatedly stalled when final payload delivery required chaining new exploit techniques after reconnaissance
